messages:
marta: Quick UX check — updated Trace Drilldown in Figma (https://www.figma.com/file/ABC). Main asks: export placement, permalink copy, keyboard order, and contrast fixes. Please flag blockers.

alex: I like moving Export out of the overflow. Suggest: breadcrumb → Export → Copy link → more. Label: "Export trace (JSON)". Keep it secondary visually.

sam: Copy notes:
- Tooltip short: "Copy permalink"
- Tooltip long: "Includes correlation IDs and selected time range"
- Export toast: "Trace export ready — stacks + events. PII redaction applied if enabled."

jules: Backend:
- permalink /t/:id?from=ts&to=ts&corr=cid, short-id TTL 7d
- export ?format=json|zip, add Content-Length when known
- expose size estimate header so client can warn >1MB

emily: A11y:
- light theme mono frames fail AA; use neutral-900 or weight 600
- focus: visible 3px ring; tab order must match visual order
- aria-live: "Permalink copied for trace 12345 at 12:34 UTC"
- stack frames keyboard: arrows to move, enter/space to toggle with aria-expanded

marta: Decisions:
- Export = secondary button, always visible to the right of breadcrumb
- show micro-caption under Export with estimated size ("~92KB" or ">1MB" in red)
- tooltip copy = long variant

alex: Frontend plan:
- change DOM order and tabindex sequence
- lazy-load export worker, show spinner on first click
- add aria-describedby from copy button to live region id

sam: Will update Figma with label + tooltip + size caption by EOD :thumbsup:

jules: I'll draft the API PR for download param + size header. Sync 30m tomorrow?

marta: Yes — sync scheduled. deploy-bot: note: lint-a11y passed on branch/trace-drilldown-ux (0 warnings)

marta: Thanks all :raised_hands:
